topic: Repulsive Gravitational Force as a Witness of the Quantum Nature of Gravity
result: The authors propose a source-mass superposition and a selected measurement outcome that produce an apparent repulsive response in a probe. This is a theoretical proposal, not a reported gravitational detection.
status: Supporting source; not validation of the project hypotheses
replication: No independent replication performed by this project
common_error: A selected outcome does not by itself establish an unconditional repulsive force or a propulsion mechanism.
correction: Account for every measurement outcome, its probability and momentum exchange; specify the assumptions under which a classical alternative is excluded.
review_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic record checked; not a full-text audit.

topic: Weak value amplification is suboptimal for estimation and detection
result: This statistical analysis finds no improvement from weak-value amplification for the estimation and detection tasks under its assumptions. Discarding outcomes has a resource cost; the treatment also considers technical noise.
status: Supporting source; not validation of the project hypotheses
replication: No independent replication performed by this project
common_error: A larger selected signal is not automatically a more informative experiment.
correction: Compare estimators at equal preparation count and elapsed time, including failed selections and the specified noise model.
review_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic record checked; not a full-text audit.

topic: Measuring gravitational attraction with a lattice atom interferometer
result: The project uses this lattice atom-interferometer experiment as its measured gravitational-attraction baseline. The deposited data and the project reanalysis are available on this site.
status: Supporting source; not validation of the project hypotheses
replication: No independent replication performed by this project
common_error: The project retains an unresolved discrepancy between 553 deposited rows and 552 described blocks. Geometry assumptions limit further interpretation.
correction: Reproduce the released-data checksum and uncertainty calculation, then recover apparatus metrology before fitting an additional force.
review_scope: Existing project reanalysis and deposited-data assessment; publisher full text not re-audited.

topic: MICROSCOPE mission: final results of the test of the Equivalence Principle
result: MICROSCOPE compared the acceleration of titanium and platinum test masses in orbit. Its final analysis found no weak-equivalence-principle violation within its reported statistical and systematic uncertainties.
status: Supporting source; not validation of the project hypotheses
replication: No independent replication performed by this project
common_error: A bound for these materials and this orbital environment is not automatically a bound on every screened model.
correction: Translate the proposed coupling into material charges and environmental response before comparing it with the measured Eötvös parameter.
review_scope: Primary abstract and bibliographic record checked; not a full-text audit.
